item.title: Are LLMs still surprisingly bad at some simple tasks?
item.description: Last year I ran an experiment to test the ability of modern LLMs to correctly answer a relatively straightforward question. Every single one of them got it wrong. Some missed information, some made up false statements, none were right. Of course the fanbois variously claimed that I was holding it wrong, my prompts were shit, I should have chosen better defaults, and - my favourite - that it…

item.title: Book Review: How to Build a Space Station by Jonathan Morrison ★★★⯪☆
item.description: This book, by The Times' former Architecture Correspondent, stands in direct opposition to A City on Mars. Whereas that book presented a (perhaps too) sceptical look at the realities of living on other planets, Jonathan Morrison's book goes (perhaps too far) in the opposite direction. item.description: Do riders in autonomous vehicles think that they are in a private space?
